Maria: Moving out — free Denon soundbar (S-710) and LG 34WN780 ultrawide (34" 3440x1440). Pickup in Williamsburg tomorrow afternoon. They'll fit in a sedan if you help carry. DM me if you want both or just one.
Devon: Are they still available? :eyes:
Maria: Yup. Prefer local pickup. Can hold til 6pm.
Alex: I’ll take the monitor if Devon wants the soundbar.
Devon: Can do soundbar. Does it come with remote and optical cable?
Maria: Remote + power cable included. Optical cable I can throw in. No VESA kit for the monitor (it's the stand model).
Sahil: Shipping by carpool? happy to pick up and deliver to BK if needed.
Maria: Appreciate it but prefer whoever claims first — if you can pick up earlier for both, DM me. I'm also open to a small donation to the team lunch fund instead of payment :)
ops-bot: Reminder — please do not post payments or personal info. Use DM for logistics.
Alex: Can pick up at 5:15pm. Address: 96 Berry St, Apt 3A (Wburg). Send me the apt buzzer code in DM.
Maria: Cool — holding monitor for Alex. Devon, hold soundbar till 5pm. If no show, first DM wins.
Sam: :thumbsup: Would be great if someone rehomes the soundbar — solid unit.
Devon: Thanks — will be there by 4:50pm.
Maria: Perfect. Leaving a Post-it on the door with my name. DM me for extra details. Cheers!
